diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-001.descripcion: An identifier appeared in a position where it is not allowed.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-001.solucion: Check whether a reserved word was misspelled. For example, use MASK instead of MAS. If it was a network name, write it after NAME.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-002.descripcion: A character or fragment that does not belong to the language was found.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-002.solucion: Remove the unsupported symbol or replace it with valid tokens such as IP, MASK, HOSTS, NAME, numbers, commas, or CIDR masks.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-003.descripcion: A reserved word uses a different uppercase/lowercase combination from the one defined by the language.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-003.solucion: Write reserved words exactly as IP, MASK, HOSTS, or NAME. Example: IP 192.168.1.0 MASK /24 HOSTS 50.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-004.descripcion: A number or CIDR mask is directly attached to letters without a valid separator.
diagnosticos.codigo.LEX-004.solucion: Separate the elements with a space. Example: HOSTS 50 NAME Oficina or MASK /24 HOSTS 50.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-001.descripcion: A complete IP address was expected after IP.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-001.solucion: Write a complete IPv4 address. Example: 192.168.1.0.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-002.descripcion: The reserved word MASK was expected after the IP address.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-002.solucion: Place MASK after the IP address. If you wrote MAS or another variant, change it to MASK. Example: IP 192.168.1.0 MASK /24.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-003.descripcion: A slash-prefixed mask was expected after MASK.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-003.solucion: Write the mask in CIDR format. Example: /24.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-004.descripcion: At least one number was expected after HOSTS.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-004.solucion: Write at least one host count. Example: HOSTS 50.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-005.descripcion: Another number was expected after a comma.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-005.solucion: Correct the host list. Valid example: HOSTS 100,200.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-006.descripcion: An identifier was expected after NAME.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-006.solucion: Write a name after NAME or remove NAME if you will not use a network name.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-007.descripcion: An instruction identical to a previous one was declared.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-007.solucion: Remove the repeated instruction or change its IP, mask, hosts, or name.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-008.descripcion: The tokens exist, but they do not appear in the expected order.
diagnosticos.codigo.SIN-008.solucion: Make sure the instruction follows: IP <IP_ADDRESS> MASK <SUBNET_MASK> HOSTS <NUMBER>[,<NUMBER>...] [NAME <IDENTIFIER>].
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-001.descripcion: The CIDR mask is syntactically valid but outside the allowed range.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-001.solucion: Use a mask between /8 and /30. Example: MASK /24.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-002.nombre: Base IP is not a network address
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-002.descripcion: The specified IP does not match the network address for the given mask.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-002.solucion: Use the correct network address for that mask. For example, for 192.168.1.5/24 the correct network is 192.168.1.0.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-003.descripcion: A host count must be greater than zero.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-003.solucion: Change the host count to a positive number. Example: HOSTS 50.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-004.nombre: Hosts do not fit in the base network
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-004.descripcion: The total requested VLSM blocks exceed the capacity of the base network.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-004.solucion: Use a larger base network, for example /23 instead of /24, or reduce the requested host counts.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-005.descripcion: One host request requires a VLSM block larger than the entire available base network.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-005.solucion: Reduce the host count or use a base network with greater capacity.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-006.descripcion: A valid base network overlaps another base network declared earlier.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-006.solucion: Change the base IP or mask of the later network so their IPv4 ranges do not overlap.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-007.descripcion: The address has four numeric components, but one or more octets are outside the IPv4 range.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-007.solucion: Correct every octet so its value is between 0 and 255. Example: 192.168.1.0.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-008.descripcion: A base network used earlier was declared again with different data.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-008.solucion: Use a different base network or modify the existing declaration instead of redefining the same IPv4 space.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-009.nombre: Base IP reused with another mask
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-009.descripcion: The same network address was declared again with a different mask, creating incompatible IPv4 spaces.
diagnosticos.codigo.SEM-009.solucion: Use another base address or keep a single definition of that address with the appropriate mask.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-001.descripcion: There are errors, but valid blocks are also available for processing.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-001.solucion: Review the lines with errors. The system will continue only with valid blocks.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-002.nombre: Reserved word attached to its value
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-002.descripcion: A reserved word is directly attached to the following value.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-002.solucion: Separating the elements with spaces is recommended. Example: IP 192.168.1.0 MASK /24 HOSTS 50.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-003.descripcion: Two or more instructions use the same network name.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-003.solucion: Use different names to avoid confusion in the VLSM table, Excel export, or result interpretation.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-004.descripcion: The host list contains repeated quantities within the same instruction.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-004.solucion: Check whether the repeated host counts are intentional. Otherwise remove or correct the duplicated values.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-005.descripcion: The base network provides at least sixteen times the capacity actually required by the VLSM requests.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-005.solucion: Consider a more specific base mask to use the available address space more efficiently.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-006.descripcion: The network name is too generic and may cause confusion.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-006.solucion: Use a more descriptive name, for example OficinaCentral, LaboratorioRedes, or SucursalTepic.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-007.descripcion: The instruction does not include a name to identify the network.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-007.solucion: Add NAME followed by an identifier to make results and reports easier to read.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-008.descripcion: HOSTS values are not written from largest to smallest, although TecNet Finder can sort them internally for VLSM calculation.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-008.solucion: Writing the values from largest to smallest is recommended. Example: HOSTS 100,50,20.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-009.descripcion: The base network matches or overlaps an IPv4 range intended for special use.
diagnosticos.codigo.ADV-009.solucion: Verify that the special-use range matches the purpose of the network. TecNet Finder will still allow the VLSM calculation to continue.
diagnosticos.codigo.GEN-001.descripcion: The error was detected but does not match a specific category.
diagnosticos.codigo.GEN-001.solucion: Review the general structure of the instruction.
